full_prompt_en: A square comic-book illustration is divided into eight narrow character head studies arranged in two horizontal rows. Thin pale gutters separate the vertical cells, turning the image into a compact gallery of intense faces. Across the upper row, the heads are closely cropped against individually colored backgrounds of olive, ochre, blue-green, and warm tan. Dark hair, strong brows, angular noses, and one pale beard make each silhouette distinct. The figures look in slightly different directions, but each is framed from the shoulders or neck upward so the face remains dominant. In the lower row, saturated violet, green, yellow, and rusty orange fields intensify the contrast. One face has pale hair and blue-green features, another is heavily shadowed in purple, a third wears a bright yellow pointed headpiece around the eyes, and the final gray-haired figure is marked by deep lines and a strong white beard. Black ink contours and dense short hatching describe wrinkles, hair, and shadow planes. Color is laid in energetic patches rather than smooth photographic gradients; small flecks and stippled marks roughen the backgrounds and skin tones. The strongest highlights strike brows, cheeks, hair ridges, and the yellow headpiece, while dark contours carve the expressions with abrupt changes of value. Each cell has its own color mood, yet the repeated vertical format and shared drawing technique hold the set together. There are no legible labels within the chosen image. The overall composition feels crowded and charged, using repeated close-up faces, varied color fields, and muscular linework to create a fast comic rhythm.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形漫画插画分成上下两排、共八格狭窄的人物头像习作。细浅色分隔线划出竖向单元，使图像成为一组紧密的强烈面孔。上排各头像被紧密裁切，背景分别是橄榄色、赭色、蓝绿色和暖褐色。深色头发、浓眉、棱角分明的鼻子以及一位人物的浅色胡须，让各自剪影不同。人物视线略有变化，但都从肩或颈部向上取景，脸始终占主导。下排饱和的紫、绿、黄和锈橙色域加强反差。其中一张脸有浅发和蓝绿色面部，另一张沉在紫色浓影中，第三张戴着围住眼睛的鲜黄尖角头罩，最后一位灰发人物满脸深纹，并蓄浓密白须。黑墨轮廓和密集短排线描出皱纹、毛发和阴影平面。颜色以有活力的斑块铺开，而非光滑摄影渐层；小色点和点描痕迹粗化背景与肤色。最强亮部击中眉骨、脸颊、发脊和黄色头罩，深色轮廓则以突然的明度变化雕刻表情。每格有自己的色彩氛围，重复的竖向格式和共同的线描技法又把它们连成一组。所选图像中没有可读标签。整体构图拥挤且充满能量，靠重复的面部特写、变化的色域和有力线条形成快速漫画节奏。
style_prompt_en: Comic-book drawing uses assertive black contours, dense directional hatching, and small speckled marks to give forms a rough printed energy. Color appears in distinct saturated fields of ochre, teal, violet, yellow, and rust rather than a single smooth wash. Close cropped focal forms fill repeated narrow spaces, so differences in angle and value create rhythm across the layout. Highlights catch raised planes abruptly, while deep ink shadows cut into recesses and preserve dramatic expressions. The overall surface is busy but controlled, with hard edges and textured color working together.
style_prompt_zh: 漫画线描运用果断的黑色轮廓、密集定向排线与细小点痕，赋予形体粗粝印刷般的活力。赭色、蓝绿、紫、黄和锈色以分明饱和色域出现，而非单一平滑薄涂。紧裁的焦点形体填满重复的窄空间，因此角度与明度差异在布局中形成节奏。亮部突然落在凸起平面，深墨阴影切入凹处并保留戏剧性的表情。整体表面繁忙但受控，硬边与有肌理的色彩协同作用。
theme_en: A grid of eight expressive comic-book character head studies
theme_zh: 八格表情鲜明的漫画角色头像习作
name: Chris Claremont
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
